text:
Sara: Quick sync — we need final ops for tomorrow's APAC-friendly webinar.
Sara: Main asks: 1) replay window rules per region (APAC 72h, EMEA 7d, NA 14d) 2) automated multilingual captions/transcripts (EN, JP, KO) 3) immediate inbound lead routing to regional SDR queues
Daniel: Got it. Zoom settings to confirm: cloud recording (separate files), auto-closed captions ON, SRT export enabled, pass through live transcript to S3. I'll also enable participant timestamps.
Daniel: Quick checklist:
• Record to cloud -> separate audio/video
• Enable Auto Captioning -> English
• Post-process: send to transcription job for JP/KO
Mike: We can auto-run the transcription job in the post-processing pipeline. Need S3 path + event ID. Example config I'll drop:
```
S3_BUCKET=redwood-webinars
PREFIX=events/2000478910/
TRANSCRIBE_LANGS=["en","ja","ko"]
ON_COMPLETE=lambda://webinar-transcode
```
Mike: After upload, the clip-splitter will create 3 clips: intro, demo, Q&A and produce SRTs and VTTs for each language.
Lee: For lead routing: two rules
1) If registrant.region in [APAC] -> SDR_APAC_queue
2) If registrant.company_size > 500 -> AE_inbound_queue
Lee: We'll also flag 'watched_replay' events for 30s+ to trigger nurture.
Anna: Registration page tweak: add explicit consent checkbox for EU, and separate timezone selector. Also add 'Send me replay' CTA (default on) to reduce drop-offs.
Sara: Good. Can we have follow-up flow timeline?
Daniel: Timeline
- Recording finished -> ZoomCloud callback -> S3 upload (~10m)
- Post-process (split + transcribe) -> within 30m
- Lead push to SFDC/HubSpot -> within 15m of registration or watch event
- Replay email sent: APAC after 20m, EMEA after 1h, NA after 4h
Mike: One caveat: Zoom's auto captions for JP/KO are poor. We'll prefer ASR->human-review for JP if registrants > 200. We can mark as 'needs-review' and swap to generated captions once reviewed.
Sara: Risk: GDPR consent missing = cannot send replay in EU. Anna please add consent copy and opt-in default = off for EU.
Anna: Will do. I'll draft copy and ping legal.
ZoomBot: Recording started by Sara (host) • Cloud recording • Captions enabled
Daniel: Thanks bot :thumbsup:
Lee: Routing test tomorrow at 09:30 PT? I can send 5 test registrants to exercise all queues.
Sara: Schedule it. I'll book a 15-min runbook review 08:45 PT.
Mike: I'll validate S3 lifecycle and retention: 30 days for APAC replays, 90 days for enterprise customers.
Sara: Perfect. Final owners: Sara (program), Daniel (zoom/ops), Mike (recording/transcode), Lee (lead routing), Anna (reg page & privacy). Any blockers?
Anna: Need legal signoff on consent copy by EOD today.
Lee: I need API key rotation window tomorrow morning (will coordinate with infra).
Sara: Noted. Thanks everyone — rolling to runbook update after legal signoff :rocket:
